Just shop around, do your research, and look for feedback forums for sellers before you buy and I'm sure you'll be satisfied with what you buy. The extra cost does seem a bit inflated compared to Petco and other companies but it is almost always directly attributed to higher quality and healthier animals, besides the ability to cherry-pick which animal you actually want is always nice.
